groups.name: cratis.arc
groups.description: Configuration for the Arc Spring Boot host.

groups.name: cratis.arc.endpoints
groups.description: HTTP command and query endpoint route settings. Arc identity endpoints use their fixed /.cratis routes.

groups.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries
groups.description: Observable-query snapshot, direct streaming, and multiplexed hub limits.

groups.name: cratis.arc.tenancy
groups.description: Tenant resolver strategy, precedence, required resolution, and claim-membership access settings.

properties.name: cratis.arc.correlation-header
properties.description: Request and response header carrying command and query correlation identifiers.

properties.name: cratis.arc.coroutine-parallelism
properties.description: Maximum number of Arc request coroutines that may execute concurrently.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.connection-timeout
properties.description: Maximum SSE connection lifetime. Zero disables the transport timeout.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.keep-alive-interval
properties.description: Interval between idle Ping messages. Zero disables heartbeats.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.maximum-connections
properties.description: Maximum concurrent direct and multiplexed streaming connections.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.maximum-inbound-message-size
properties.description: Maximum accepted WebSocket text message size in bytes.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.maximum-subscriptions-per-connection
properties.description: Maximum active subscriptions on one multiplexed connection.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.outbound-buffer-capacity
properties.description: Bounded pending outbound frames per streaming connection.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.overload-retry-after-seconds
properties.description: Retry-After value used by 503 and 429 overload responses.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.wait-for-first-result-timeout
properties.description: Maximum default wait for an observable HTTP snapshot's first result.

properties.name: cratis.arc.observable-queries.web-socket-enabled
properties.description: Whether WebSocket routes are registered when Spring WebSocket is present.

properties.name: cratis.arc.endpoints.enable-query-http-method
properties.description: Whether one-shot and observable snapshot query endpoints also accept the RFC QUERY HTTP method. GET is always available.

properties.name: cratis.arc.expose-exception-details
properties.description: Whether full exception details may be returned. Defaults to true only for explicitly active dev, development, or local profiles.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenant-header
properties.description: Backward-compatible alias and default for cratis.arc.tenancy.header-name.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.resolvers
properties.description: Resolver strategies in complete precedence order: fixed, header, query, claim, subdomain, development.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.required
properties.description: Whether command, query, observable, and identity requests without a resolved tenant fail closed.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.header-name
properties.description: Case-insensitive tenant header. When unset, cratis.arc.tenant-header is used.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.query-parameter-name
properties.description: Exact case-sensitive tenant query parameter name.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.claim-type
properties.description: Claim used for tenant resolution and authenticated tenant membership.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.base-domain
properties.description: Multi-label DNS base domain required by subdomain resolution.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.fixed-tenant-id
properties.description: Tenant returned by fixed and development resolution.

properties.name: cratis.arc.tenancy.constrain-to-authenticated-claims
properties.description: Whether authenticated tenant claims constrain header, query, and subdomain selections.
